title: Workflow Automation incident and digest template mappings: which notification and survey templates are used per source type, source action and notification type

prose.text: {{purpose}} {{default-mappings}} The templates being mapped are in [[zwa.notifications]] and [[zwa.notifications.survey-templates]].

prose.label: Source actions.
prose.text: {{inline-actions}} {{saas-actions}} {{endpoint-actions}} {{email-actions}} The full Inline and SaaS Security action lists are open {{gap:unquoted-actions}}.

checks.do: Whether the notification and survey templates have been added before adding an incident template mapping.
Whether the user and DLP admin digest notification templates exist before adding a digest template mapping.

purpose.statement: Incident template mappings determine which notification and survey templates Workflow Automation uses for end user notification and escalation notifications; the digest template mapping determines the templates used for digest notifications.

quotes: Incident template mappings determine which notification and survey templates Workflow Automation uses when it generates the notifications for the different notification types (end user notification and escalation).
The digest template mapping determines which templates Workflow Automation uses when it generates the digest notifications for your organization.

default-mappings.statement: Workflow Automation provides a default source action for each source DLP type (Inline, Email, Endpoint and SaaS Security), mapped to the default notification and survey templates; the templates on these default mappings can be changed and the mappings deleted.

quotes: Workflow Automation provides a default source action for each source Data Loss Prevention (DLP) type (Inline, Email, Endpoint, and SaaS Security).
These default actions are mapped to the default notification and survey templates that Workflow Automation provides.
You can change the notification and survey templates associated with these default mappings, and you can delete them.

incident-prereqs.statement: Before adding an incident template mapping, notification templates must be added on the Notification Templates page and survey templates on the Survey Templates page.

quotes: Add notification templates on the Notification Templates page in the Zscaler Admin Console.
Add survey templates on the Survey Templates page in the Zscaler Admin Console.

digest-prereq.statement: Before adding a digest template mapping, user and DLP admin digest notification templates must be added on the Notification Templates page.

quotes: Before you can add a digest template mapping, add user and DLP admin digest notification templates on the Notification Templates page in the Zscaler Admin Console.

source-and-notification-types.statement: Adding an incident template mapping asks for a source type (Email, Endpoint, Inline or SaaS Security), a source action (which depends on the source type) and a notification type (End User Notification or Escalation).

quotes: select the source type. Source types are Email, Endpoint, Inline, and SaaS Security.
The available source actions depend on the source type you select.
Notification types are End User Notification and Escalation.

inline-actions.statement: Inline source actions for a template mapping include Violates Compliance Category Archived To Mailbox, Violates Compliance Category Archive To Mailbox Failed, Allowed And Archived To Mailbox and Allowed And Archived to Mailbox Failed.

quotes: Violates Compliance Category Archived To Mailbox
Violates Compliance Category Archive To Mailbox Failed
Allowed And Archived To Mailbox
Allowed And Archived to Mailbox Failed

saas-actions.statement: SaaS Security source actions for a template mapping include Report Malware, Apply Email Tag, Report Incident, Notify End User, Apply Azure Information Protection Label, Apply BOX Tag, Move To Restricted Folder, Apply Google Drive Label, Remove Public Link Sharing and Quarantine To User Root Folder.

quotes: Report Malware
Apply Email Tag
Report Incident
Notify End User
Apply Azure Information Protection Label
Apply BOX Tag
Move To Restricted Folder
Apply Google Drive Label
Remove Public Link Sharing
Quarantine To User Root Folder

email-actions.statement: The Email source actions for a template mapping are Default, Quarantine, Allow, Block, Custom Header Insertion, Justify and Caution.

quotes: - Default - Quarantine - Allow - Block - Custom Header Insertion - Justify - Caution

endpoint-actions.statement: The Endpoint source actions for a template mapping are Default, Allow, Block and Confirm.

quotes: - Default - Allow - Block - Confirm
evidence.after: Allowed And Archived to Mailbox Failed

template-family-fields.statement: An incident template mapping's Template Family section has Email, Slack, Teams and Survey fields for choosing a template family; the Slack field is only available with the Slack integration and the Teams field only with the Microsoft Teams integration, and on an existing mapping only the Template Family values can be edited.

quotes: Email: From the drop-down menu, select the email notification template family for the incident and notification type.
Slack: From the drop-down menu, select the Slack notification template family for the incident and notification type.
Teams: From the drop-down menu, select the Microsoft Teams notification template family for the incident and notification type.
Survey: From the drop-down menu, select the survey template family for the incident and notification type.
This field is only available if you have integrated Workflow Automation with Slack.
This field is only available if you have integrated Workflow Automation with Microsoft Teams.
You can only edit the template values in the Template Family section of the edit window.

digest-mapping-fields.statement: The Digest tab of Template Mappings has, under both User and DLP Admin, Email, Slack and Teams template drop-downs for digest template families; the Slack Template field is only available with the Slack integration and the Teams Template field only with the Microsoft Teams integration.

quotes: From the Email Template drop-down menu, select a user digest email notification template family.
From the Email Template drop-down menu, select a DLP admin digest email notification template family.
From the Slack Template drop-down menu, select a user digest Slack notification template family.
From the Teams Template drop-down menu, select a user digest Microsoft Teams notification template family.
From the Slack Template drop-down menu, select a DLP admin digest Slack notification template family.
From the Teams Template drop-down menu, select a DLP admin digest Microsoft Teams notification template family.
The Slack Template field is only available if you have integrated Workflow Automation with Slack.
The Teams Template field is only available if you have integrated Workflow Automation with Microsoft Teams.

unquoted-actions.title: What are the full Inline and SaaS Security source action lists?
unquoted-actions.detail: The page lists more Inline actions (Default, Violates Compliance Category, Allowed) and more SaaS Security actions than the two claims quote, which are written as partial lists.
